name: Hibikino Yui
source:
School Year: Freshman
Occupation: Student

"Keep it down! Quit it with all this eroge talk!"

As the youngest sister who's not comfortable with adult content, she still can't accept their home renovation. 

Disliking lewd things, she hopes their home can be changed back into a normal store as soon as possible.

She's at the age when she wants to try new things, but at the same time she feels the need to oppose her sisters. It's frustrating that she can't do anything by herself.

In reality, she doesn't detest her sisters' actions as much as she lets on. It just happens that sometimes she gets brash with her wording. One could say it's the other side of her feelings for her family and the protagonist.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.cuffs.co.jp/products/hibikino/]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]She's also the fledging VTuber Hinoki Yui.[/spoiler]
